commands.command:
mkdir -p /etc/inventory /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
SRC_HOST=10.100.202.10
DEST=/etc/inventory/app.conf
TMP=/etc/inventory/.app.conf.tmp
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 root@"$SRC_HOST" 'cat /etc/inventory/app.conf' > "$TMP"
if [ ! -f "$DEST" ] || ! cmp -s "$TMP" "$DEST"; then
    mv "$TMP" "$DEST"
    logger -t sync-inventory-conf "app.conf updated from $SRC_HOST"
else
    rm -f "$TMP"
fi
EOF
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
